# Zeyn

> Zeyn is an open source Rust web framework for data heavy business apps: grids, forms and workflows. AI agents write the application code and people review it. Screens are rendered on the server, so app code has no HTML, CSS or JavaScript. Status: alpha (0.0.10 on crates.io); APIs still change.

## If you are an AI agent asked to build an app with Zeyn

Do not write the project by hand. Install the CLI and let it create the project:

```sh
cargo install zeyn-cli
zeyn new my-app
cd my-app
cargo run
```

The app listens on http://127.0.0.1:3000 (change `server.addr` in `config/app.json`). Then:

1. Read `my-app/AGENTS.md` and `my-app/.claude/skills/zeyn/SKILL.md`. They hold the rules and the patterns for this framework.
2. Add features with `zeyn g feature <name>`: it creates `src/features/<name>/` with the folders `models/`, `services/`, `actions/` and `screens/`, one file per model, service, action and screen, and a working list screen. Add a screen with `zeyn g screen <feature> <name>`. Add `components/` by hand when a part of a screen is shared.
3. Run `zeyn check` and `cargo test` after every change. Compiler errors say what to change.
4. `.mcp.json` registers `zeyn mcp`, an MCP server with the tools `zeyn_docs`, `zeyn_describe`, `zeyn_check`, `zeyn_test`, `zeyn_new_feature` and `zeyn_new_screen`. `zeyn_docs` has the topics `rules`, `language` and `protocol`.

For a library of features shared by several apps use `zeyn new my-domain --lib`.

Rules that fail the build or the tests if broken: every action and screen declares `permission = "..."` or `public`; every user facing text comes from the locale files (`t!("key")`, English and Turkish); use `DataGrid`, `DataQuery`, `Form` and `Screen` from `zeyn::prelude`, not hand written HTML.

## Languages

These docs are written in English, and the English pages below are the source. Every page is also translated into Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Korean, Japanese, Hindi and Arabic, at the same path behind the language code: https://docs.zeynsoft.com/tr/, /zh/, /ru/, /es/, /ko/, /ja/, /hi/ and /ar/ (for example https://docs.zeynsoft.com/tr/language/datagrid). A page whose translation is behind the English source is shown in English there. Prefer the English pages.

Every page is also served as Markdown: add `.md` to its address (`/index.md` for the start page, `/tr/language/datagrid.md` in a language). The links below point to the Markdown. All English pages in one file: https://docs.zeynsoft.com/llms-full.txt
